note: The fixture pair for cold-start (L11 in fixtures/PLAN.md), scanned with cold-start alone. Written by hand: each planted defect is fixed in place in the clean twin, line for line, and the twins differ in nothing else. A finding catches a defect when its check matches and its locations name the defect's file, line, column and symbol (every place, when the defect lists several), with the defect's severity. Decoys are in both twins; reporting one is a false positive. The fixes are guided. The clean twin builds each value with a top-level await on its declaration line, so app.js, which imports these modules, listens only once they are ready; the first-use check in the function becomes a comment on the same line. Paths are relative to each twin. Nothing here is installed or run.
